facts.business: Khoobsurat Limited is engaged in investments and trading of shares and securities and other financial activities, meeting the criteria for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) under Section 45-IA of the RBI Act, 1934, though it has not obtained such registration.

segments.name: Investments and trading of shares and securities

auditor.name: M/s S P M L & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Mumbai (FRN - 136549W)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: 1) Certain balances of trade receivables, trade payables, and loans and advances are subject to confirmation, reconciliation, and consequential adjustments. 2) The Company meets criteria for NBFC registration under Section 45-IA of RBI Act, 1934 but has not obtained registration. 3) Stock-in-trade of shares in listed companies not currently traded valued at last available traded rates (INR 2.97 Lakhs). 4) Advances totaling INR 587.37 Lakhs given for acquisition of shares/securities pending settlement as on balance sheet date.

key_risks: Significant management judgment and estimation uncertainty in Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provisioning for financial assets including trade receivables, loans, and advances
